messages:
amy (partnerships): Quick sync: two partners reported entitlements colliding in our ledger after onboarding (same external_entitlement_id). That caused double-crediting in one account. We need a standard for namespacing external IDs and a migration plan. Thoughts? :grimacing:

noel (eng-billing): ouch. Root cause usually is partners reusing numeric ids across different product lines. Our ledger key was (external_entitlement_id) and we forgot partner namespace. We should qualify with partner_id at minimum.

rita (eng-platform): agreed. Minimum fix: change canonical key to (partner_id, external_entitlement_id). Longer-term: enforce a namespacing header on ingest and validate format. Also expose a quick diag API that maps external ids -> internal entitlement(s).

sam (solutions): partners asked whether they need to change anything. Some partners already have downstream systems depending on the bare id. Can't break them without notice. We need migration with backwards compatibility.

ada (legal): contract note: we should avoid unilateral rewriting of partner identifiers. Notify partners and provide a 60-day migration window. Also include an opt-in mapping service clause.

rita (eng-platform): migration approach proposal:
1) soft-change: update all new ingests to write and index by (partner_id, external_entitlement_id) but continue to accept lookups by old bare id.
2) emit a mapping record ledger: mapping_id, partner_id, external_entitlement_id, internal_entitlement_id, created_at. This is immutable and searchable.
3) run a retroactive normalization job that rewrites index pointers (not raw ledger rows) and produce a reconciliation report. No ledger row deletions.
4) after 60 days, reject new ingests that use bare id without partner_id header.

We'll also add a de-dupe check across partner namespaces to catch suspicious duplicates (two different partners claiming same external id).

noel (eng-billing): for reconciliation: we must ensure we don't re-credit customers. When normalizing pointers, we'll run a dry-run to surface accounts that would change entitlement mapping and produce reversal + re-credit plan if necessary. Any re-credit > $100 needs finance approval. Also keep all change diffs in audit logs.

amy (partnerships): partner-facing plan: send notice explaining namespacing, timeline, and provide a short API example showing adding partner_id header. Offer a migration endpoint where they can POST a batch of external_entitlement_id->internal mappings to pre-seed.

ada (legal): include a required HMAC on bulk mapping uploads to prevent spoofing and a clause for liability limits in case their bulk upload contains errors that affect billing.

rita (eng-platform): API example we'll require:
```
POST /marketplace/entitlements/claim
Headers:
  X-Partner-Id: helixai
  X-Partner-Signature: base64sig...
Body:
  {"external_entitlement_id":"plan-2026-std","customer_reference":"acct-123"}
```
Server will compute canonical_key=(partner_id||":"||external_entitlement_id). We'll index both that and legacy_bare_id for 60 days.

noel (eng-billing): ops note: we'll need to rebuild some query-side materialized views. Recommend a staged rollout: staging -> canary -> prod. Also add an alert if an external_entitlement_id appears under >1 partner in production (suspicious) so partnerships can triage.

amy (partnerships): partners that can't add headers can use the migration endpoint to register mappings. We'll also provide a weekly reconciliation CSV for the migration window.

rita (eng-platform): security note: mapping endpoint must be limited to a partner service account with signed requests. We'll log IPs and sig verifications. Also throttle the migration job to avoid DB spikes.

audit-bot: entitlement-namespace-scan job: found 12 external_entitlement_ids present under multiple partner_ids in prod. Created incident tickets for each. :mag:

amy (partnerships): next steps & owners:
- eng to implement dual-index + mapping ledger + diag API (rita/noel)
- legal to draft partner notice + contract amendment language (ada)
- partnerships to contact affected partners and run migration support (amy)
- solutions to assist partners with mapping (sam)
Target: rollout to staging in 10 days, partner notice out in 7 days. Tagging @rita @noel @ada @sam. :white_check_mark:
